description:
If you’ve ever wanted to experience China beyond the guidebooks, come travel with us:
littlechineseeverywhere.com/tours

We are exploring Yunnan’s Nujiang Valley — one of China’s most remote border regions, stretching between Myanmar’s Kachin State and the Tibetan Plateau.
Home to many ethnic groups, including the Lisu people, Nujiang is a place of unique cultures, languages, and traditions. Many Lisu communities here are Christian, with their own language and even a fascinating writing system.
Join us as we explore this hidden valley and discover a side of China that few people have ever seen.
